name: impreza-child-theme
description: Production-ready Impreza child theme with build system

scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && git stash push -u -m 'Stashing before production deploy' && git add -f impreza-child-dist/ && git commit -m 'Build for production deployment' && git branch -D production 2>/dev/null || true && git subtree split --prefix impreza-child-dist -b production && git push origin production -f && git reset --hard HEAD~1 && git stash pop || true
